messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from today's UX review. Dropping new frames for the batch vectors preview + rerank + export flow: https://figma.redwood/vec-export-v1. Looking for feedback on: keyboard reorder, drag-handle a11y name, CSV encoding and quoting behavior, and export CTA wording.

Lina Park: Love the reorder handle. One note: we need a keyboard reorder affordance (power users like keyboard-only moves). Proposal: when a row is focused, allow `Ctrl+ArrowUp/ArrowDown` (or `Meta` on Mac) to move the row and update preview order. Add a small tooltip for first-time use.

Tom Becker: CSV details: we must support non-ASCII text and Excel on Windows. Recommend adding UTF-8 with BOM option for exports and a delimiter selector (comma/pipe/tab). Also add a note in the modal: "Use Tab-delimited for Excel compatibility on some locales."

Priya Patel: Copy suggestions: Primary CTA should remain stable label `Export` with a visible counter chip `3 selected` next to it. For SR users, include an sr-only variant `Export 3 vectors` so screen readers get immediate context. For the async exports message use: `Processing export in background. We'll email a link when ready.` Keep it under the CTA in smaller text.

Jordan Li: Accessibility / interaction notes: drag handle should have `role=button` and `aria-label="Reorder vector"` and be keyboard focusable. When focused, announce movement tips: `Press Ctrl+Up or Ctrl+Down to move`. For the keyboard reorder, use a live region announcing `Row moved to position 3` on change.

a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) Roving tabindex on list (role=list/listitem). 2) Drag handle focusable with descriptive aria-label. 3) Live region for selection count and reorder confirmation. 4) Export CTA sr-only full label. 5) Modal focus trap and descriptive aria-describedby for CSV options. 6) Contrast checks for counter chip and BOM option toggle.

Maya Chen: Nice. On CSV quoting: if text contains newlines we should quote fields and preserve original line breaks. Also provide a preview sample in the modal (first 3 rows) with a small `Show raw` toggle so users can inspect escaping.

Lina Park: UX for large selections: when selecting >5000 vectors recommend showing `Export in background` with an estimate: "This export may take several minutes. You will receive an email with a download link." Disable confirm until job scheduled. Also add an opt-in: `Notify me when complete` checkbox defaulted on.

Tom Becker: Security/PII note: show a subtle reminder in export modal: `Do not export sensitive user data without permission.` Link to privacy policy. Telemetry should capture export_type and row_count, but redact sample text.

Priya Patel: Microcopy for drag reorder tooltip: `Keyboard reorder: focus row, then Ctrl+Up/Down (Mac: Cmd+Up/Down) to move.` For first-run hint we can show a short toast the first time someone uses it.

Jordan Li: Implementation detail: when performing keyboard reorder, ensure the DOM reflow doesn't steal focus. Keep focus on the moved item and announce new position. Use `aria-live="polite"` and clear the node between writes to avoid duplicate reads.

Maya Chen: One small UI ask: when export format options are open, we should dim the list and keep the selection state visible but read-only to prevent accidental changes during mapping. Also the CSV column mapping modal should show the default header name and allow inline edit.

Lina Park: Mobile behavior: Reorder by drag is awkward on small screens. Keep keyboard reorder for desktop; on mobile provide a `Reorder mode` that shows a condensed reorder-only view with large drag handles. Exit mode with Done.

Tom Becker: Export encoding toggle copy: `Encoding: UTF-8` with subtext `Include BOM for Excel compatibility (Windows Excel may require BOM for non-ASCII).` Default `Include BOM` = off, but show a tooltip recommending enabling for legacy Excel.

Priya Patel: Final export confirm copy suggestion: `Export 3 vectors as CSV — includes: id, text, relevance_score` and a small line `Customize columns in mapping` linking to modal. For telemetry: do not include raw text, only column names and counts.

Jordan Li: A11y-bot reminder: also test VoiceOver iOS for column header announcements (use explicit `aria-label` on header cells e.g., `Relevance score, higher is more relevant`).

Maya Chen: Action items: @Lina prototype keyboard reorder hint + mobile reorder mode; @Tom add CSV BOM and delimiter options to modal spec and sample preview; @Priya finalize sr-only text and confirm modal strings; @Jordan add live region snippet and drag-handle aria examples. I'll collect and update Figma by EOD Friday. Ping me if blocked. :sparkles:
